* ​**Recharge your Sunday:** Get some light movement and great conversation in, setting a positive tone for the week ahead.

これは、初心者向けのオンライン俳句イベントです！✨
作ったことがなくても全く問題ありません。
季語や基本のルール、表現のコツなどを、先生が丁寧に教えてくれるので、すぐにでも自分のオリジナル俳句が作れるようになっちゃいますよ！
俳句や短歌を作りながら、日本語のボキャブラリーも楽しく学べます🇯🇵🖋️
日本語ならではの奥深い表現や、美しい言葉の文化を一緒に体験しましょう！
やさしい日本語や英語での参加もOK！
自分のペースで、日本の詩文化を楽しみながら体験できます🌸
👥 Perfect for anyone who wants to:

* Try Haiku or Tanka for the first time
* Learn more about Japanese language and culture
* Enjoy creative writing and language exchange

👥 こんな方におすすめ

* 俳句や短歌をはじめて体験してみたい方
* 日本語や日本文化に興味がある方
* 創作や語学交流が好きな方

💡 Who can join:

* Those who can read Hiragana and Katakana
* Those who can greet in Japanese
* Anyone interested in Japanese poetry!

💡 対象レベル

* ひらがなやカタカナが読める方
* 日本語であいさつできる方

🎟️ How to Join
Try a free trial lesson first!

* Just click the "Join" button to get your Zoom link and jump straight into the class!

Want to try more classes for free? Sign up [here](http://community.welearn.co.jp/)!

* 7-Day Free Trial: Unlimited access to ALL classes on [this page](https://community.welearn.co.jp/ja/search)!
* Cancel anytime, no strings attached.
* If you love the class, we’d love to welcome you as a permanent member of our community!
* Looking forward to seeing you there! 😊

**🇯🇵 About Us**
We are **WeLearn Community**, an online Japanese learning community! People from all over the world who love the Japanese language and culture gather here to learn and connect online.
Our management team is made up of Japanese students, working professionals, and Japanese language teachers who all share a passion for international exchange.

* "I want to practice chatting in Japanese!"
* "I want to make Japanese friends!"

If that sounds like you, you are more than welcome to join us! Please feel free to check out our lessons and online events. We can’t wait to learn and have fun together!
